rows: A Simple Job With One Odd Detail
An {initiating_actor} requests a straightforward task involving {target}, but one detail does not fit the stated reason.
The odd detail becomes more important once preparation begins.
What changes if the stated reason is incomplete rather than false?
A second stakeholder asks for a different outcome.
Why is the odd detail present?
What does the patron omit because they think it irrelevant?
An {initiating_actor} asks for help reaching or recovering {affected_actor} from {location}.
Available information is incomplete and may already be outdated.
What does delay change for the missing or trapped party?
The person to be rescued may not want the expected rescue.
Who else has a claim on the situation?
An {initiating_actor} needs a {target} delivered to {location} under unusual restrictions.
The restrictions make ordinary routes or methods inappropriate.
What happens if delivery is delayed, inspected or rerouted?
Another party offers a reason not to complete the delivery as asked.
Who is allowed to know the cargo or destination?
Both Sides Ask for the Same Mediator
Two opposed actors separately request help resolving a dispute.
Each side assumes the mediator already understands a different version of the conflict.
What gets worse if the dispute remains unresolved?
A third stakeholder reveals they were excluded from negotiations.
What does each side consider non-negotiable?
An {initiating_actor} asks for specialized help assessing {target} because ordinary experts cannot or will not agree.
The assessment itself could shift ownership, legitimacy or risk.
Who gains from each possible interpretation?
A party attempts to influence the assessment before it is complete.
What cannot be verified from available evidence?
Escort Someone Who Changes the Route
An {initiating_actor} asks for protection or escort of {affected_actor}, but the traveler has goals not fully aligned with the sponsor.
The traveler requests a deviation that creates new risk.
Whose authority defines a successful escort?
The sponsor and traveler issue incompatible instructions.
What does the traveler want independently?
An {authority_actor} or interested party asks for recovery of {evidence} needed to settle a current question.
The record may implicate the requester or undermine the expected conclusion.
What decision is stalled without the record?
A partial copy appears in someone else’s hands.
Why was it lost or hidden?
Help Is Needed, But Authority Cannot Ask
An {authority_actor} or insider needs assistance but cannot publicly authorize it.
The lack of official backing means success and failure may both be politically deniable.
What protection exists if unofficial actors are exposed?
A competing official order contradicts the private request.
Who knows the request is unofficial?
An {affected_actor} asks the characters to investigate an accusation against them rather than simply accept their denial.
They provide useful evidence but also withhold one uncomfortable fact.
What changes if they are partly truthful rather than wholly innocent or guilty?
The withheld fact becomes public from another source.
What are they protecting even if innocent of the accusation?
The Sponsor Offers More Than Payment
An {initiating_actor} offers access to an {opportunity} in exchange for help with a bounded problem.
The offered access creates a relationship likely to outlast the immediate task.
What future expectations come with accepting patronage?
A rival sponsor offers a competing path.
What does the sponsor actually want long-term?
Can the opportunity be separated from the relationship?
An {affected_actor} is publicly blamed for {past_event} before evidence has been tested.
An {authority_actor} must act quickly because the accusation is already changing behavior.
What is lost while blame remains unresolved?
New evidence weakens one accusation but creates another.
A Right to Belong Is Challenged
Someone contests an {affected_actor}'s status, membership, title or access.
The challenge invokes a rule or tradition that has not been tested recently.
What privileges or relationships depend on recognized status?
A precedent emerges that helps one claim and harms another.
What definition of belonging is being used?
Someone Is Accused of Crossing a Line
An {affected_actor} is accused of violating a serious rule involving {target}.
The alleged act may have prevented a different harm, complicating simple judgment.
What happens if intent and rule violation point in different directions?
A witness changes their account after pressure.
What exceptions, if any, are recognized?
Two People Claim the Same Standing
Two actors make incompatible claims to one identity, office, inheritance or authority.
Both possess evidence strong enough that ordinary recognition fails.
What decisions cannot wait for certainty?
A third party recognizes both claims for different purposes.
Can both claims be partly valid?
Who defined the identity or office?
A crisis creates pressure to identify one responsible {affected_actor}, and a politically convenient target emerges.
Evidence is weak but public certainty rises faster than investigation.
What does quick punishment prevent or enable?
Actual responsibility appears distributed across several actors.
Who is afraid of a broader inquiry?
An {affected_actor}'s work, discovery or sacrifice tied to {past_event} is publicly attributed to someone else.
The false or incomplete attribution now carries material rewards or authority.
What has already been distributed based on the wrong story?
Correcting the record would harm an innocent beneficiary.
Trust Is Challenged by an Apparent Betrayal
An {affected_actor} appears to have violated an {obligation} at a critical moment.
Circumstances make both betrayal and coerced failure plausible.
What alliance or duty fails if trust collapses?
Evidence shows the actor hid something unrelated to the alleged betrayal.
An {affected_actor} is found with {target} they are not expected or permitted to possess.
They can explain some but not all of how it came into their hands.
What legal, social or supernatural consequences follow from possession?
The item's recognized owner cannot explain its own movements.
A celebrated result involving {target} is challenged as fraudulent, staged or misrepresented.
A credible critic produces evidence that undermines part but not all of the achievement.
What funding, trust or policy rests on the celebrated result?
The critic has a conflict of interest that does not invalidate the evidence.
A group connected to {location} or {past_event} is blamed collectively for a recent harm.
Individuals within the group disagree over response, responsibility and cooperation.
What collective penalties or retaliations are being proposed?
Evidence narrows responsibility while broad anger grows.
